_meta.description: Polished modern Mahjong solitaire for iPhone and iPad. Provably solvable boards, procedural music, Game Center leaderboards & challenges. No ads. Plays offline.
a-more-flexible-ipad.e48cc8: A more flexible iPad experience and modernized Game Center
a-polished-modern-mahjong.92d9ba: A polished modern Mahjong solitaire for iPhone and iPad. Tap two matching free tiles to break the pair, build a combo, and clear the board. Every deal is provably solvable. No ads. No tracking. Plays offline.
a-procedural-engine-there.5380f9: A procedural engine — there are no pre-recorded tracks. Each theme has its own character (Ivory is plucky, Midnight is brooding, Cyber is synthwave) and the engine schedules notes through AVAudio with sample-accurate timing so it never stutters. Toggleable from Settings, respects the silent switch.
a-real-challenge-not.1d6241: A real challenge, not a slot machine.
after-a-win-send.36e5f6: After a win, send a real native Game Center challenge tied to your actual leaderboard entry. They get an in-game banner with the score to beat.
american-the-default-follows.de8dc1: American (the default) follows the modern western convention: any flower matches any flower, any season matches any season. Strict requires an exact identity match for every tile — and because flowers/seasons only ship as singles, Strict mode drops them from the pool entirely and substitutes extra winds so every tile has a partner.
are-there-ads-or.cc7da0: Are there ads or in-app purchases?
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
combine-any-layout-with.e305c7: Combine any layout with one of six themes and four face sets. Want Classic Mahjong tiles on a midnight background with a lo-fi soundtrack? Done. Want full-color animal emoji on a synthwave Cyber theme? Also done.
completely-the-full-game.310580: Completely. The full game works in airplane mode. Leaderboard submission and challenges sync up the next time you're online.
each-theme-ships-with.f3a164: Each theme ships with its own non-repetitive procedural music engine driven by AVAudio's sample-accurate scheduler. Respects your silent switch.
every-board-is-generated.e84b6f: Every board is generated via reverse-removal — we simulate a valid play-through first, then deal the tiles into the resulting order. No more random shuffles that lock you out two minutes in.
fast-clears-multiply-your.ca23f4: Fast clears multiply your score. Combo streaks stack up to 5×. A misaimed tap breaks the streak — so does using a hint, but only if you cash it in.
garden-pyramid-turtle-cross.d358a0: Garden, Pyramid, Turtle, Cross, Diamond, Tower, and Bricks. Each one is 144 tiles tuned for portrait phones and reads beautifully on iPad.
is-tilebreak-available-in.5a1587: Is Tilebreak available in the European Union?
leaderboards-and-the-dashboard.4ea0bb: Leaderboards and the dashboard now open through the latest Game Center experience, keeping score sheets quick and current.
made-with-care-shipped.2a813f: Made with care, shipped with care.
mix-ivory-jade-midnight.2487a6: Mix Ivory, Jade, Midnight, Cherry, Lantern, or Cyber with Classic Mahjong, Icons, Garden, or Animals tile faces. Live-switch any of it from Settings without dropping your game.
no-ads-no-tracking.84fde3: No ads. No tracking. No analytics. No required sign-in. Plays everywhere, including airplane mode. Game Center features need a connection but the core game does not.
no-to-both-tilebreak.6a1a5a: No to both. Tilebreak is a one-time purchase. There are no ads, no in-app purchases, no required sign-in, and no tracking. Game Center is opt-in for leaderboards and challenges.
pick-a-layout-pick.2cec53: Pick a layout. Pick a style.
seven-layouts-six-themes.7f28c6: Seven layouts, six themes, four face sets, two rule variants — and not a single ad in sight
swiftui-spritekit-hybrid-60.08b000: SwiftUI + SpriteKit hybrid, 60 fps cap, zero third-party SDKs. Stack lift, side walls, and shadows are all proportional so the board scales cleanly from iPhone mini to iPad 13".
tap-two-matching-tiles.494962: Tap two matching tiles to remove them. A tile is "free" if nothing is stacked on top of it and at least one of its left or right sides is open. Most tiles need an exact match — under American rules, any flower matches any flower and any season matches any season.
the-app-icon-is.62d542: The app icon is procedural too: two matching Red Dragon tiles flanking a burst of sparks, generated by a Swift script so it can be tweaked and re-rendered in seconds. The whole thing is iOS 26 native and built against Swift 6 strict concurrency.
the-end-screen-pulls.d68b12: The end screen pulls your personal best from Game Center and shows it next to every stat. Beat your record and the row goes gold — there's no ambiguity about whether you crushed it.
the-window-resizes-freely.8bd34e: The window resizes freely in Split View, Stage Manager, and iPad windowing — the home screen, tutorial, and title hero all adapt to the window instead of the device, so small windows stay tidy.
three-global-leaderboards-best.1474f8: Three global leaderboards: best single-game score, fastest clear, and longest combo. End-of-game screen shows your personal record next to each stat and highlights a new best in gold.
tilebreak-is-hand-built.a623b2: Tilebreak is hand-built in SwiftUI and SpriteKit — no Unity, no third-party SDKs, no analytics, no ads. The classic Mahjong tile faces are drawn procedurally in CoreGraphics so they look crisp at any tile size.
tilebreak-isn-t-sold.a2a848: Tilebreak isn't sold on the App Store in the European Union — under the EU Digital Services Act, selling there requires publishing a trader listing with personal contact details, which I've opted out of as an independent developer. It's also not currently offered in France. It's available in every other App Store territory.
tilebreak-ships-with-seven.74135b: Tilebreak ships with seven board layouts — from the classic Garden, to a brick-stacked Pyramid, to a Latin Cross that fans out across the screen. Whichever you pick, the deal is provably solvable.
time-and-combo-both.418814: Time and combo both matter. A fast clear with a long streak posts a serious score. A slow clear with broken combos posts a fine one. Used a hint? Took an undo? You'll see the deduction.
what-s-the-difference.34bd31: What's the difference between American and Strict rules?
yes-each-board-is.243716: Yes. Each board is generated by simulating a valid play-through first (the reverse-removal method) and then dealing the tiles into the resulting order. Even after a shuffle mid-game, the new layout is regenerated to be solvable.
yes-native-ipad-support.59fa42: Yes — native iPad support in both portrait and landscape. The board scales up to fill the bigger screen with proportional tile size, stack lift, and side-wall depth so the visual stays consistent.
zero-third-party-dependencies.a096e5: Zero third-party dependencies. Built on Swift 6 with strict concurrency.
